sources.relevance: PDF page 4 replaces the earlier Digital Plan Submission Standards and Procedures; pages 4-7 contain digital standards. The guide describes AEP systems; AER Manual 018 section 3.1 also references it for plan/CAD source dependencies. Exact artifact, regulator, exception and current edition must be resolved.
